I highly recommend Saawariya Opticals to anyone in search of high-quality eyewear and exceptional service. They have earned a loyal customer in me, and I'll definitely be returning for all my optical needs. Thank you, Saawariya Opticals, for setting a new standard in eyecare.

featured_reviews.name: RG Fire
featured_reviews.review_text:
Subject: Great Brand, Disappointing Staff Experience at Bhayandar West
​I have immense respect for Mr. Piyush Bansal and the work he has done with Lenskart, which is why this experience was so disappointing. My first visit to this store was convincing, but my second visit was completely not up to the mark.
​The Issues:
​Uncooperative Staff: The employees were unhelpful and the general treatment was inappropriate.
​Lack of Knowledge: When I asked for an XL size frame (which is available on the website), a staff member insisted that "Wide" is the maximum size and refused to check further.
​Zero Support: After denying my request, the staff member walked away to the entrance, leaving me to browse and check all options entirely on my own.
​Rushed Billing: The checkout process was rushed. The staff did not explain the lens options or pricing. Even when I raised a serious concern about the selected power being wrong, they seemed in a hurry to just complete the transaction rather than ensure accuracy.
​The Positive:
The manager at this branch is decent and cooperative, which is the only saving grace.
​Verdict:
I would only recommend this specific store to customers who know exactly what they want and are willing to do the selection entirely on their own. Do not expect guidance or support from the floor staff here.
